bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; DEST="$ROOT/.worktrees/sticker-current"; test "$(git -C "$DEST" rev-parse HEAD)" = bcf35887ea430873e792b2f8fabdb3f8b1555c35 || exit 43; docker image inspect node:22-alpine >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 46; docker run --rm --network none --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev --security-opt no-new-privileges -v "$DEST:/work:ro" -w /work node:22-alpine node --test test/stickerGeometry.test.mjs test/stickerPackRegistration.test.mjs test/stickerWizard.test.mjs
